description.value: 54th Ave Cafe is a neighbourhood Chinese restaurant in Vancouver's South Vancouver/Killarney area serving a broad menu of Cantonese staples including congee, BBQ meats, noodle soups, and chow mein. The restaurant offers both eat-in dining and a fully integrated online ordering system for takeout and delivery. Its extensive menu and community-oriented atmosphere make it a practical meal stop for cyclists riding the nearby routes along 49th Avenue or the Central Valley Greenway.
